sources.snippet: While this approach may impact model performance, we believe that the long-term benefits of openly sharing training data far outweigh the trade-offs by fostering future research and development. A wide variety of use cases leverage AI systems capable of understanding human speech and analyzing visual information such as graphs and tables.
